resources.string: Sign up for free at virustotal.com, then open “API key” from your profile menu. Free keys have a limited number of requests per day.
Create a project in Google Cloud Console, enable the “Safe Browsing API” and create an API key under “Credentials”.
Only when VirusTotal doesn’t know the file, and only after you confirm each time.
Warning: files uploaded to VirusTotal are shared with its community and researchers and cannot be deleted. Don’t upload files containing personal data.
Explain results in plain language with Gemini (only when you tap the button).
A notification when a scan finishes or has important findings. No background monitoring.
Notification permission was not granted. You can enable it in Android settings.

API keys are stored encrypted on this device. Only file hashes (SHA-256) and URLs are sent to providers; files themselves are uploaded only with your explicit consent. There is no server of ours – the app talks to providers directly.
APK Qo‘riqchi AI helps you assess risk using data from public services. It does not replace Google Play Protect or an antivirus, and no result is a 100% safety guarantee.
Send a small real request to each provider to check your key and connection.
401/403 or “invalid key”: copy the key again without spaces and save it.
429: daily or per-minute quota used up. Wait a while or upgrade your plan.
Offline: check Wi‑Fi or mobile data, VPN and DNS settings.
Safe Browsing 400/403: make sure the “Safe Browsing API” is enabled in your Cloud project and check the key restrictions.
Delete data, permissions and privacy policy
All saved API keys will be removed from this device. External services won’t work without them.
The app has no server of its own and uses no analytics or ad tracking.
For APK scans, the file’s SHA-256 hash is sent to VirusTotal. The file itself is uploaded only if you enabled that setting and confirm it explicitly.
For link checks, the link you enter is sent to Google Safe Browsing and/or VirusTotal.
When you ask for an AI explanation, only the scan results (the evidence text) are sent to Google Gemini API. On Gemini’s free tier, Google may use this data to improve its services.
API keys are stored encrypted with the Android Keystore and scan history stays on your device only. Each provider processes data under its own policy.

Delete history and keys with the buttons above. To remove everything, go to Android Settings → Apps → APK Qo‘riqchi AI → Storage → “Clear data”, or uninstall the app. The app cannot delete files already uploaded to VirusTotal – contact VirusTotal for that.
Sign in to aistudio.google.com with your Google account and create a free key via “Get API key”.
The app ships with no keys – enter your own free keys. They are stored encrypted on this device only and sent only to their own provider. Local checks work without any keys.
